headline: Congress, AAP, Akali Dal satisfied with Punjab SIR while Congress protests CEC in Delhi
caption:
Delhi mein protest, Punjab mein tareef. Ye kaisa twist hai? 😅
Congress ne Delhi mein CEC Gyanesh Kumar ke khilaf protest kiya.
Usi beech poll-bound Punjab mein Congress, AAP aur Akali Dal ne SIR process par satisfaction jataya.
Congress neta Hardeep Singh Kingra ke mutabik unhone Punjab CEO Anindita Mitra ke saamne kai issues uthaye aur unhe suna gaya.
Delhi wala protest ya Punjab wali tareef: asli Congress kaun si hai? 🅰️/🅱️

Follow @khabarbawaal for daily updates.
Source: Inshorts - Stay Informed (link pinned in comments 👇)
